text:
Morgan: quick check before I apply a TF change to tenant namespaces — adding eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn to the serviceAccount Helm chart values. Will this blow up existing pods that mount projected tokens? I'm seeing some namespaces still using legacy iam annotations and a couple older namespaces with kube2iam bits.

infra-bot: auto-check: detected 12 namespaces with svcacct annotation mismatch. Suggest running `make ns-scan` and `./scripts/irsa-compat-check --namespaces tenant-*`. Report will include any SAs that have `iam.amazonaws.com/role` instead of `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn`.

Sam: you can add the annotation, but don't have both `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` and the legacy `iam.amazonaws.com/role` on the same SA. Also confirm these SAs are using projected service account tokens (k8s 1.20+ default) — otherwise IRSA won't work.

Morgan: here's the values I'm about to apply in helm for the uploader chart (staging):

```
serviceAccount:
  create: false
  name: tenant-uploader
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/tenant-uploader-role"
```

Natalie: FYI double-check that the IRSA trust policy has `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` for the cluster's OIDC provider. We had a drift last week where the role existed but the trust relationship pointed to an old OIDC thumbprint and pods got 403s. Also ensure role session name rules are sane.

Terry: also watch Terraform state: if this SA is managed elsewhere (k8s_service_account in TF) you might get a mid-air collision. Is this SA currently created by TF or only Helm?

Morgan: it's only created by Helm for these namespaces. Plan: run `helm template` -> diff against live cluster -> then run `./scripts/irsa-compat-check` -> apply to staging. If all good, I'll open a small TF change to manage the IAM role (not the SA). Anyone want to review before I apply in staging at 20:00 PST?

Sam: quick LGTM from me, run the compatibility script and ping me if any namespaces show `iam.amazonaws.com/role`. If you see that, we should do a one-off remediation (remove legacy annotation) before annotating.

Natalie: +1 from infra/security side. Add a permcheck in the PR — a one-liner that asserts the role's trust policy includes the cluster OIDC ARN — so ops can approve faster. :thumbsup: 

Morgan: thanks — will post the helm diff here after template and run `./scripts/irsa-compat-check`. Will also attach the role trust policy snippet for review.

infra-bot: scheduled: scan job queued (id: scan-20260317-09). Results will be posted to #incidents if anomalies found.

Terry: pinging @Sam @Natalie for a quick look at the helm diff when Morgan posts it.

Morgan: posted helm diff (relevant snippet):

```
- annotations: {}
+ annotations:
+  eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/tenant-uploader-role"
```

Sam: ok, looks safe from my side. :thumbsup:

Natalie: approve from security side — trust policy looks correct.

Morgan: applying to staging now, will report back with scan output and pod behavior (expected no restarts, tokens should refresh).
